lines: 1 Comparison
• Comparative and superlative forms of adjectives
The most common way to compare things is to use these forms of the adjective.
Examples: Hassan is older than me. | Yousif is the oldest boy in the class.
• as
We use a positive statement with as to say that things are equal. We use a negative statement (as + not) to show that things are not equal.
Examples: My sister is as tall as me. | My friends are as interested in football as I am. | My car is not as fast as yours.
Note: This is the same as saying: My car is slower than yours.
• same
This word shows that things are equal. It can also be used in a negative statement.
Examples: My sister is the same height as me. | My cousin is not the same age as me.
Note: The word same is followed by a noun, not an adjective. The word can also be used at the end of a sentence.
Examples: These two colours are/aren't the same.
• like/unlike
The two words are not adjectives but they are used to make comparisons.
Examples: Like my father, I am interested in sports. Unlike my father, I am not interested in football.
Note: The underlined phrases can be used at the end of a sentence or at the beginning. In both cases, a comma separates them from the rest of the sentence.

simple_explain.html:
الفارق الجوهري في اختيارات الامتحان الوزاري:

  • as + adjective + as: يأتي بينها صفة مجرّدة (as tall as).
  • the same + noun + as: يتبع same اسم وليس صفة (the same height / age as)، وقد تأتي the same في آخر الجملة (are the same).
  • Like / Unlike + noun phrase, ...: مفصولة بفاصلة، وتُستخدم للشبه أو الاختلاف.

example.html:
Salim is as tall as Tariq. = Salim is the same height as Tariq.
My pen is not as expensive as yours.

lines: 2 Contrast
• however/although
These two words can be used to give the same meaning as but.
Examples: Although he worked hard, he didn’t pass his exam. | He worked hard. However, he didn't pass his exam.
Note: They contrast unexpected relationships between two actions or events.
• whereas
This word can be used to give the same meaning as but.
Examples: Whereas Ahmed worked hard, his brother didn't.
Note: It can only be used to describe opposites.
Find examples of comparison and contrast in the texts.
Now do activities A, B and C in the Workbook.

simple_explain.html:
أدوات التناقض والتبايُن في الدرس:

  • Although: تربط جملتين متناقضتين غير متوقعتين (رغم أنّه اجتهد، لم ينجح) وتبدأ إحدى الجملتين دون الحاجة لنقطة قبلها إذا جاءت في الوسط.
  • However: تفيد المعنى نفسه لكنها تأتي عادة في بداية الجملة الثانية متبوعة بفاصلة (. However, ...) أو في آخر الجملة مسبوقة بفاصلة.
  • Whereas: تُستخدم حصراً للمقابلة المباشرة بين طرفين متعاكسين في الصفة أو الفعل (Ahmed worked hard, whereas his brother didn't).

example.html:
Although it was raining, we went out.
It was raining. However, we went out.
Whereas Arabia is hot, mountain peaks in South America are cold.

activities.prompt_literal: 1.5 A Read this paragraph about three sisters. Then complete the sentences.
activities.prompt_ar: اقرأ الفقرة التالية (ملاحظة: كُتب الاسم «Noura» ثم «Nura» في السطر التالي بالطبعة الرسمية) ثم أكمل الفراغات:

items.prompt: Aisha is 16 years old. She has two sisters, Noura and Huda. Noura is 17 and Huda is 11. Nura is 1.78 metres and so is Aisha. Noura is the ______ of the three. Although Aisha is ______ than Noura, she is as ______ her sister. Since she is only 11, Huda is the ______ of the three.

hints: الأعمار: Noura 17 (الأكبر)، Aisha 16 (أصغر من نورة)، Huda 11 (الأصغر بين الثلاث).
لاحظ وجود as قبل الفراغ الثالث، لذا يلزم كتابة «tall as» أو تحديدها في الخيارات.
الحل: oldest ، younger ، tall as ، youngest.

activities.prompt_literal: B Write these sentences another way. Use words from the box: most · like · same · not · as
activities.prompt_ar: أعد صياغة الجمل الأربع مستعملاً الكلمات من الصندوق (most, like, same, not, as):

items.question: Bill's car is white and Richard's is blue. → Richard's car is ______ colour ______.
items.model_answer: Richard's car is not the same colour as Bill's.
items.explain_ar: نفي التساوي باستعمال not the same + noun (colour) + as.

items.question: Two brothers, Ahmed and Hassan, got 90% in their English exam. → ______, Ahmed got 90% in the examination.
items.model_answer: Like Hassan, Ahmed got 90% in the examination.

items.question: My pen was not expensive, but my friend has a very expensive one. → My pen was ______.
items.model_answer: My pen was not as expensive as my friend's.
items.explain_ar: نفي المساواة بـ not as + صفة + as.

items.question: There are three classes in year 1. Class A has 30 pupils, class B has 35 pupils and class C has 33 pupils. → Class B has ______.
items.model_answer: Class B has the most pupils.
items.explain_ar: صيغة التفضيل للعدد الأكبر: the most pupils.

hints: 1) not + the same + colour + as، 2) Like ...، 3) not as ... as، 4) the most pupils.
انتبه لوضع الفاصلة بعد Like Hassan في الجملة 2.

activities.prompt_literal: C Complete the sentences using however or although.
activities.prompt_ar: أكمل الجمل الآتية باستخدام however أو although مع مراعاة موضع الفاصلة والنقطة:

items.prompt: Football is a very popular game, ______ not everybody enjoys it.
______ I like fishing, I don't catch a lot of fish.
The factory manager gets very angry sometimes. ______, he is very good at his job.
The book wasn't very interesting. I read it from start to finish, ______.

hints: تأتي Although في بداية جملة متبوعة بجملتها، وتأتي However بعد نقطة ومتبوعة بفاصلة أو في نهاية الجملة.
1: although (في وسط جملة)، 2: Although (في أول الجملة)، 3: However (بعد نقطة وقبل فاصلة)، 4: however (في ختام الجملة).

questions.stem: Which sentence correctly uses 'same' according to PB page 4?

options.text: My sister is the same height as me.
My sister is the same tall as me.
options.why_wrong: قاعدة الكتاب تنص: The word same is followed by a noun (height), not an adjective (tall).

options.text: My sister is same height than me.
options.why_wrong: تُسبق same بأداة التعريف the وتتبعها as وليس than.

options.text: These two colours are same as.
options.why_wrong: في نهاية الجملة يُقال: are/aren't the same بدون as.

hints: اقرأ الملاحظة تحت بند same في PB ص 4.
الصحيح: the same height as me.
questions.explain: كلمة same يتلوها اسم (مثل height أو age) مع the ... as، ولا يتلوها صفة.

questions.stem: According to PB p. 4, what is 'whereas' strictly used to describe?

options.text: Opposites (direct contrast between two subjects or things).
Equal measurements in height and age.
options.why_wrong: التساوي يُعبَّر عنه بـ as...as أو same وليس whereas.

options.text: Causes and results of past actions.
options.why_wrong: الأسباب تستخدم because / because of، أما whereas فهي للتضاد.
whereas أداة ربط للتناقض (contrast) وليست أداة استفهام.

hints: انظر آخر سطرين في قسم Contrast من PB ص 4.
ابحث عن جملة: Note: It can only be used to describe...
questions.explain: تنص قاعدة الكتاب ص 4 صراحةً على أن whereas تُستعمل لوصف الأضداد والمقابلة المباشرة (opposites).
